title: How Do I Schedule an Appointment? – Curve Dental
markdown:
[Skip to main content](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50525569711379-How-Do-I-Schedule-an-Appointment#main-content)

* * *

Appointments can be created entirely within the **Scheduler**, or created in tandem with treatment plans made in the **Charting** module.

To make an appointment on the scheduler, first bring up the patient in the sidekick, then click and drag down on the scheduler to create a box. This will prompt the user to add details to make it a full appointment.
